The plate is square and about 26 cm across, so it works as a dinner plate. The food is a few pieces of cheese pizza, roughly 3 slices of rectangular focaccia-style pizza. Together they measure about 14 x 6 cm and are about 1.5 cm thick, which comes to roughly 130-150 g. There is also a small pile of arugula salad of about 30 g and 2 black olives of about 6 g.

Pizza at about 2.7 kcal/g gives about 380 kcal for 140 g. The arugula adds about 10 kcal plus a little dressing oil, call it 40 kcal. The olives add about 8 kcal.

That makes about 180 g in total and about 400 kcal.
